notes.title: Optimization Open Test
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We tried to improve the animation optimization in the game, but on some systems it may cause crashes. Therefore, we ask for your help to test the stability of this version.

⚠️ DISCLAIMER: when switching to the branch, your saves may break. Save them in advance (AppData\LocalLow\OneMoreTime\Tavern Manager Simulator)

Here’s how to access it:

 Go to your Steam Library
 Right-click on Tavern Manager Simulator → Properties
 Go to the Betas tab
 Enter this code: svgdfrgWewgvWEsf
 Select the beta branch and let it update!


What to do in the game:

1. Play for 30 minutes with the option disabled (disabled by default)
2. Launch the game three times and exit after a minute.
3. Enable the option at the end of the settings, play again
4. Fill out the survey (link on the screen in the menu)
5. Send an in-game report with the title "about optimization" and indicate whether there were any crashes.


Thank you so much!

notes.title: Cleaning and Improvements | Tavern Manager Simulator v1.0.11
notes.content:
Oktoberfeast is over.  Thank you all for participating. And now improvements are here!

Gameplay:

 New fairy profession - cleaner. She cleans dirty footprints, scattered trash, dirty spots from the table and cleans the toilet (available from level 8)
 New line of improvements - mats at the entrance. They reduce the amount of dirty footprints left by guests.
 New improvement - remote opening/closing of the tavern right from the bar counter.


Improvements:

 A green arrow now appears above the table if new customers are approaching it.
 Changes in the gold counter are now written in gold, so as not to confuse it with reputation.
 The fullness of the warehouse is also displayed in the inventory.
 More plates for meat from the start.


Fairies:

 The logic of fairies has been reworked - they are better at choosing what and where to carry and should not fall into a stupor from carrying the wrong items to the wrong place.
 Increased flight speed.
 Markers now appear above tables if fairies are about to bring an order to that table or remove dirty dishes from it.


Optimization:

 Improved performance, optimized complex visual areas - the game should work faster and put less load on the system.

 The toilet. We made changes as you requested. Now it is much closer, and it gets clogged less often. It is also visited by real visitors when the tavern is open.
 Fixed problems with displaying Asian fonts.
 Fixed a lot of bugs.

 Turkish

notes.title: DevLog #4 Tavern Development
notes.content:
Tavern development is one of the key features in the game. You will feel how your Tavern grows bigger and better. Gain experience, earn gold, and buy new level.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/d6ce12529998a84ceabc3fa6c4034711fdbd025a.png

Level 1
A small, modest building. If you clean it up, you can put in a few tables.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/c3ec43eb4bce41e844078e5b1baaa9e9b6d8582d.png

Level 5
Now we have a kitchen! You can cook hot soup and tasty meat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/1263e8cd0e948ef651641c2c6bdcead2cb368e66.png

Level 10
Two floors! Now there's definitely enough space for everyone. Maybe we can even set up a stage for artists.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/de7a3587e29e6fbb907307d2fac0d63c507b09e2.png

Level 15
Time to dance and listen to lively music! It would be great to have a summer terrace.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/f3a55cbe68560b199aa68d7e70dc7bff9da8d789.png

Join us in Discord! https://discord.gg/suYcCmPeXe


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/da8b1ca645f41cd6e8db23975ee738b39ef09715.gif

notes.title: DevLog #2 Weather
notes.content:
Day and Night
Now the game features a full day and night cycle. Lanterns light up at night, and you can even see the lights in the castle on the hill. Maybe there's a princess waiting for you there?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/8608c9133767a10fa677899d2a769c2f97029447.gif

Different Weather
We have added various types of weather conditions. From rain to a meteor shower. No matter what the weather is like outside - the tavern awaits guests.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820925/70e8f26e4399ffe44ce60fd37f37ac32b80b6960.png

Add To Wishlist
Add to wishlist and follow to stay up to date with the game and support us.
